selection: source-VAL participant-average fixed-five Macro-F1; earliest best on ties; improvement >1e-8
normalization: reuse verified full-physical-TRAIN statistics from P3A
anchors: TRAIN-only medoid bank per seed; seed 123 reuses verified P3A bank; same bank across baselines within seed
epoch_order: existing trainer torch.randperm with checkpointed global RNG; model stochastic operations may change order across later epochs
class_collapse: record one predicted class or >=98% largest predicted-class fraction; retain scientifically negative results
gate_a_cost_estimate: 3 seeds x 60 x sum of four measured epoch durations; no assumed early stopping discount
execution: one CUDA training process; gate A pauses seed-123 runs after epoch one under this unchanged configuration
